release_notes:
- First installation on a Mac is more reliable: Nexus SR now checks that every R package it needs actually loads before it says the installation is done, and reinstalls the ones that do not. If your Mac is too old for the R version you installed, it tells you so before downloading anything, with what to do about it.
- The first installation downloads far fewer packages (about 180 instead of 700), so it is faster.
- If the installation fails, the reason is shown in a dialog instead of only in the log file.
- On the next start, Nexus SR runs this check once on computers that already have it installed, which takes about a minute. Nothing else changes.
